verdicts.reason: A keeps the original's centred stack, so the logo, sale ribbon, bottle, headline and CTA all read in the same order as the original. Its flaws: the ribbon has shrunk and become a weak accent, and the headline, subcopy, CTA and legal line are crammed together at the bottom with the legal line close to the edge, while the middle is left loose. B breaks the composition. The logo and ribbon sit at opposite corners, the bottle drifts left with dead space beside it, and the subcopy is squeezed into a narrow ragged column left of the CTA. The legal text is wrapped into a tiny unreadable 6-line stack on the right, and the three-column bottom row looks arbitrary and cramped.
